welcome.label: Welcome Email
welcome.subject: Welcome to Your College D2L — Your Onboarding Starts Here
welcome.body:
Dear {{firstName}},

Welcome to Your College! The eLearning Office is here to support you as you prepare for your first semester teaching with Brightspace (D2L).

Your next steps:
1. Log in to D2L: {{loginUrl}}
2. Complete your profile
3. Enroll in the Faculty Orientation course
4. Create your sandbox course for practice

Your assigned eLearning specialist is {{assignedSpecialist}}. We will schedule an introductory meeting soon.

If you have questions, reply to this email or contact us at {{elearningEmail}}.

Best regards,
Your College eLearning Office

login_nudge.label: Login Nudge
login_nudge.subject: Reminder: Please Log In to Your College D2L
login_nudge.body:
Dear {{firstName}},

We noticed you have not yet logged in to Brightspace (D2L). Getting started early helps ensure your courses are ready before the semester begins.

Log in here: {{loginUrl}}

If you need help with your username or password, contact the IT Help Desk.

Your eLearning specialist ({{assignedSpecialist}}) is available to walk you through setup.

Best regards,
Your College eLearning Office

meeting_invite.label: Meeting Invite
meeting_invite.subject: eLearning Onboarding Meeting — {{firstName}} {{lastName}}
meeting_invite.body:
Dear {{firstName}},

It is time to schedule your onboarding meeting with the eLearning Office. During this session we will:

• Verify your D2L account and profile
• Walk through the Faculty Orientation course
• Set up your sandbox course
• Discuss your first-semester course development timeline

Please use our booking link or reply with your availability.

Best regards,
{{assignedSpecialist}}
Your College eLearning Office

course_review_ready.label: Course Review Ready
course_review_ready.subject: Your Course Is Ready for Pre-Semester Review
course_review_ready.body:
Dear {{firstName}},

Great progress on your course development! Your eLearning specialist would like to schedule a pre-semester course review.

Before our meeting, please verify:
• Module structure is consistent
• All links work
• Gradebook calculations are correct
• Accessibility items are addressed

Reply to schedule your review session.

Best regards,
{{assignedSpecialist}}
Your College eLearning Office

week1_checkin.label: Week 1 Check-in
week1_checkin.subject: Week 1 Check-in — How Is Your First Week Going?
week1_checkin.body:
Dear {{firstName}},

Congratulations on launching your first week of classes in D2L!

A few quick reminders:
• Post a welcome announcement if you have not already
• Monitor early student engagement in the Class Progress tool
• Respond to student questions within 24–48 hours

If anything feels overwhelming, your eLearning team is here to help. Reply anytime.

Best regards,
{{assignedSpecialist}}
Your College eLearning Office

midterm_grades.label: Midterm Grade Reminder
midterm_grades.subject: Reminder: Midterm Grade Deadline Approaching
midterm_grades.body:
Dear {{firstName}},

This is a friendly reminder that midterm grades are due soon for {{firstTeachingSemester}}.

Please ensure your gradebook is up to date and grades are submitted on time. If you need help with grade calculations or the submission process, contact the eLearning Office.

Best regards,
{{assignedSpecialist}}
Your College eLearning Office

final_grades.label: Final Grade Reminder
final_grades.subject: Reminder: Final Grade Deadline — {{firstTeachingSemester}}
final_grades.body:
Dear {{firstName}},

Final grades for {{firstTeachingSemester}} are due soon. Please finalize your gradebook and submit grades before the deadline.

If you have incomplete students, contact the Registrar before submitting final grades.

Need a refresher? The eLearning Office offers final grade training sessions.

Best regards,
{{assignedSpecialist}}
Your College eLearning Office

debrief_invite.label: Debrief Invite
debrief_invite.subject: Semester Debrief Meeting — {{firstName}} {{lastName}}
debrief_invite.body:
Dear {{firstName}},

Congratulations on completing your first semester at Your College!

We would like to schedule a debrief meeting to:
• Review what went well and areas for improvement
• Discuss course copy-forward plans
• Plan advanced training for your second semester

Please reply with your availability or use our booking link.

Best regards,
{{assignedSpecialist}}
Your College eLearning Office

semester2_training.label: Semester 2 Advanced Training
semester2_training.subject: Advanced D2L Training Options for Your Second Semester
semester2_training.body:
Dear {{firstName}},

As you prepare for your second semester, the eLearning Office offers advanced training in:

• Advanced gradebook features
• Analytics and Class Progress
• Intelligent Agents
• AI-assisted course design workflows

Reply to schedule a personalized session with {{assignedSpecialist}}.

Best regards,
Your College eLearning Office
